texts.title: Theogony
texts.author: Hesiod
texts.summary: Hesiod's Theogony is the foundational genealogy of the Greek gods: from Chaos, Gaia and Ouranos through the Titans to the reign of Zeus. Nearly every Olympian temple in the Pantheon traces its lineage to a passage of this poem.
